style: Single Kalistar equipment asset. Detailed narrative heroic fantasy painting, visible faceted brush strokes and hierarchical edges, handcrafted worn cloth, leather and metal. Neither photograph, smooth 3D nor anime. Clearly readable complete object, no invented bends to fit the canvas, generous margins. No people, hands, words, numbers, interface, borders, watermark or unrelated equipment.

objects.object: FFIX Orichalcon dagger (French Orichalque), short pale silver leaf blade, small brass crossguard, short dark red leather grip. Not the black mechanical off-hand dagger, not a double blade.
objects.scene: Resting diagonally on the lid of a half-open wooden traveling theatre chest, quiet backstage daylight, folded muted blue cloth, only a suggestion of a distant curtain.
objects.ring: brushed pale silver blade-like bevels, brass connectors and burgundy leather insets

objects.object: Vivi's original Mage Staff from FFIX, small brown wooden staff with straight shaft and a naturally knotted bulbous carved root head, weathered leather wrap, no crystal sphere, no enormous wizard ornament.
objects.scene: Leaning on a humble wooden table beside one open old book, golden light from a low hearth, a few embers, simple plaster wall beyond. Staff is the main subject, whole shaft visible.
objects.ring: worn dark wood root grain in copper rails, very fine warm amber ember inlay

objects.object: FFIX Steiner Excalibur, noble straight pale gold-white double-edged long blade, elegant golden winged crossguard, deep blue grip and gold pommel. Preserve straight axial construction and entire point.
objects.scene: Propped beside a simple stone guard-room bench in Alexandria, broad shaft of cool daylight on the blade, one folded dull blue cloth, background kept quiet.
objects.ring: pale steel panels and old gold wing-like engravings with blue leather joints

objects.object: Beatrix's recognizable Final Fantasy IX Save the Queen, long straight narrow silver blade with repeating subtle pink-red geometric inlays along the fuller, ornate golden open scrollwork wing/heart-shaped guard, brown wrapped grip and small gold pommel. Not the FF12 weapon, no curved blade.
objects.scene: Resting diagonally against low pale stone steps of Alexandria, late afternoon light and one subdued rose petal near the hilt, sparse background, entire straight sword visible.
objects.ring: antique gold open scrollwork, silver rails and tiny rose enamel accents, restrained regal workmanship

objects.object: Freya's Dragon Hair spear from FFIX, extremely long straight dark shaft, silver-green forked draconic spearhead, small red wrapping below head and at lower grip. Entire pole and point, no bent shaft.
objects.scene: Leaning almost vertically against a rain-wet stone balustrade in Burmecia, subdued green-gray daylight, quiet arches in depth and one small crimson cloth. Pull back to show the full spear.
objects.ring: wet silver-green scales engraved around copper rails with dark red bindings

objects.object: Amarant's Rune Claws from FFIX, compact heavy golden-brass fist weapon with multiple straight tapered ivory metal talons, red-brown palm grip and engraved stepped knuckle housing. No hand inside, not an enormous gauntlet or animal paw.
objects.scene: Lying on a flat campsite rock next to its short leather fastening, early morning light, quiet distant path with minimal details.
objects.ring: worn brass knuckle segments, ivory steel claw-like engraving and dark red leather links

objects.object: Quina's Gastro Fork from FFIX, giant four-tined dinner fork with pale jade-silver prongs, straight dark reddish shaft and warm brass attachment. Clearly a large eating fork, not a trident or spear. Whole handle and four straight prongs.
objects.scene: Propped next to a single travel cooking pot on a flat campsite stone, quiet steam, warm dawn reflected on silver, muted green ground without clutter. Show whole fork.
objects.ring: pale jade-silver utensil-like metal segments with four subtle tine engravings and copper rivets

objects.object: Cinna from FFIX practical compact carpenter hammer, chunky rectangular worn steel head with blunt flat faces, short straight orange-brown wooden handle, leather grip. Simple theatrical carpenter tool, no magical jewels or giant warhammer.
objects.scene: Resting on a scarred backstage workbench beside two timber offcuts and a few nails, distant dark red curtain, warm side light, sparse set-building workshop.
objects.ring: hammered gray steel and warm wood blocks joined by small copper nails

objects.object: Steiner's recognizable FFIX knight helmet, squat rounded steel bucket helm with raised brow band, simple visor opening, blunt riveted cheek protection and short flared neck rim, worn blue-gray metal with honest dents. No horn, crown, plume, face or head.
objects.scene: Resting empty on a plain stone guard bench with a folded indigo cloth, pale morning daylight, quiet castle wall.
objects.ring: dented blue-gray riveted steel plates, thick protective lip and worn copper fasteners

objects.object: Vivi's iconic FFIX oversized tan pointed wizard hat, very broad floppy brim, tall softly bent crown, worn ochre cloth, dark stitched seams and simple dark hatband. Empty hat only, no glowing eyes, no face, no person.
objects.scene: Resting on a simple wooden stool beside a sunny window, subtle amber light under the brim, plain deep blue fabric in the distance, tender quiet scene.
objects.ring: ochre stitched fabric-textured metal insets, dark copper edging and fine warm amber seam light

objects.object: Freya's recognizable FFIX long muted crimson dragoon coat, high collar, broad shoulders, practical layered front, weathered rain-darkened wool and leather, red fabric tails. Empty naturally draped coat, no person, no spear or hat.
objects.scene: Draped over an old stone window ledge after rain, pale gray-green Burmecian daylight, just a little water on the stone and distant quiet rooftops.
objects.ring: dark crimson cloth-like insets and rain-worn silver clasps inside copper rails

objects.object: A single coherent set of Amarant's worn hand-protection bandages, two compact rolled off-white linen wraps with one short loose end, reddish leather fastening, stained and repaired fibres. No hands, no blood, no weapon.
objects.scene: Neatly set on a low campsite rock, restrained red cloth nearby, cool dawn on the folded linen and warm sunlight at the edge.
objects.ring: layered ivory linen-textured bands wrapped over dark copper, a few dark red fastening stitches

objects.object: Blank from FFIX recognizable dark reddish-brown leather eye bandana, broad horizontal band with short tied ends and small worn metal fasteners, no head or face. Supple old leather, not a pirate hat or a modern blindfold.
objects.scene: Tied loosely over a low tree branch in a recovering forest, quiet green background and one fresh leaf, soft morning light on the old leather.
objects.ring: reddish-brown leather segments, small silver studs and a fine moss-green inner seam

objects.object: Garnet's recognizable Final Fantasy IX silver pendant: faceted translucent pale blue-white teardrop crystal, silver royal-emblem bail and fine silver chain, delicate and faithful to the original, no red garnet gem, no enormous fantasy mount.
objects.scene: Hanging just above a small open royal keepsake box, ivory lining and soft clear daylight, sparse restrained background, crystal and full pendant completely visible.
objects.ring: fine royal silver filigree and translucent pale blue crystal segments, delicate white inner light

objects.object: Eiko's Mog keepsake ribbon from FFIX, small tender pink-red silk bow with two short hanging tails, worn soft fabric and a tiny pale metal clasp, no creature, wings, plush toy or person.
objects.scene: Carefully laid on a worn pale stone stair in Madain Sari, soft warm daylight, faint white magical glimmer close to the fabric, quiet background.
objects.ring: blush pink silk-like enamel loops held by fine silver rails and small warm copper stitches

objects.object: One graceful white feather keepsake inspired by Kuja of FFIX, long straight pearl quill, fine layered white and pale lavender barbs, tiny silver cuff at the base. No floating orbs, no huge magical explosion.
objects.scene: Resting on a fold of dark wine velvet after a performance, faint violet side reflection, only a quiet curtain in deep background, all feather tips visible.
objects.ring: pearl white feather-like silver engravings, wine enamel recesses and a very fine violet inner rail

objects.object: A small ancient crystalline fragment inspired by Garland and Terra in FFIX, irregular faceted cool azure crystal held upright by a spare aged silver-bronze support, subtle inner blue light. Tangible relic, no globe, no planet, no floating glass orb.
objects.scene: Standing on a worn stone plinth in a quiet ancient chamber, distant pale blue architectural shapes, light from inside the crystal, sparse close setting.
objects.ring: ancient silver-bronze stepped segments and blue crystal seams, narrow cool inner light

objects.object: Ruby's Tantalus theatre manuscript inspired by FFIX, a modest open stack of worn cream stage-script pages tied with faded red ribbon, soft brown cover folded underneath, faint illegible ink marks only. No readable text, giant spellbook, skulls or jewels.
objects.scene: On a quiet backstage table, one nearly spent candle and restrained crimson curtain in the distance, broad warm side light and dark cool shadows, pages remain main subject.
objects.ring: old copper theatre-rail segments, parchment-like cream insets and small red ribbon ties
